recommendation: 5-fold OOF CV on train split (n=700/class, fold test n=140, CI half±0.028) is the primary AUROC protocol. The 300-sample held-out test split is reserved for Classifier A quality check (§53).
note: Primary D1 AUROC uses 5-fold OOF CV on the 700-sample training split. The 300-sample held-out test split is reserved for Classifier A quality check (§53). CI half-width for CV: ±0.028 per fold (n=140); cross-concept CI: ±0.010 (n=17 concepts).

nemenyi_power.interpretation: Strategies differing by >= 4 rank positions in cross-model leaderboard are significantly different. Strategies within +-4 ranks reported as a tier.
nemenyi_power.note: ICC computed from actual layer sweep and stored in results/layer_icc.json. N_eff and CD updated then.

corpus_totals.note: All concepts target 700/class. Depression is limited by source pool size: 562 train / 241 test per class (mrjunos 200-500 + relaxed 180-520 second pass). CI ±0.043, above detection threshold.

per_concept_adequacy.note: Floor is 695 not 700 — concepts with 697-699 are deduplication artefacts with identical CI ±0.040. All concepts target the standard 700/class.

depression.note: Reaches 562 via mrjunos/depression-reddit-cleaned (200-500 token window) plus second pass at relaxed 180-520 window. CI ±0.043.
depression.domain_exception: Single domain (social) — Reddit is the only viable source for first-person mental-health text at required length.
